name: QuickBooks Online (Global)
description_en:
This record covers the QuickBooks Online product shown on Intuit’s Global site: hosted accounting with invoices, income/expenses, bank feeds and reports, with additional capabilities determined by the plan. It does not combine every regional QuickBooks edition, desktop product, payroll service or payment offer.

The central workflow is to connect or import source transactions, classify or match them with business records and review the resulting balances. Current plan scope was readable, but live monetary prices did not load in the page text obtained. No account or transaction was tested.
description_zh:
本档案研究 Intuit 全球站展示的 QuickBooks Online：包含发票、收支、银行数据源和报表的托管会计软件，更多能力取决于套餐；不把各地区 QuickBooks 版本、桌面产品、薪资及支付服务混为一体。

核心流程是连接或导入来源交易，将其分类或匹配到业务记录，再复核余额。本次读取到了当前套餐范围，但页面实时数字价格没有加载出来。未测试账户或交易。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect eligible bank accounts or manually upload transactions when the bank is unavailable.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可连接符合条件的银行账户；银行不受支持时可手工上传交易。

core_features.explanation_en: The invoicing page describes estimates converted to invoices, status tracking and payment reminders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 开票页介绍报价转发票、状态跟踪及付款提醒。

core_features.name_zh: 按套餐提供的业务控制
core_features.explanation_en: The current matrix distinguishes users, bills, inventory, projects and advanced reporting by plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前对照表按套餐区分用户、账单、库存、项目和高级报表。

pricing.billing_basis: Regional plan and billing/offer choice; live numeric quote was not readable in the obtained page.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Choose a regional edition before comparing features
sections.title_zh: 比较功能前先选地区版本
sections.en:
The Global site offers Simple Start, Essentials, Plus and Advanced. Regional sites and products are selectable separately. A feature or payment method advertised in one regional offer should not be assumed available in another. This research follows the Global pages actually read and keeps interface-language support unverified.

A small business wanting sales, expenses and its accountant in one hosted record may find the workflow relevant. A buyer seeking a local payroll/tax-filing service, a desktop license or a specific bank must verify that requirement independently. These are selection boundaries, not a reviewed relationship with any competing product. The existing unreviewed alternatives remain unapproved.
sections.zh:
全球站列出 Simple Start、Essentials、Plus 和 Advanced；其他地区站点与产品另行选择。某个地区宣传的功能或付款方式，不能自动视为另一地区也可用。本次只依据实际读取的全球站页面，界面语言支持仍未核实。

希望把销售、费用和会计协作放入同一托管记录的小企业可以评估该流程。若采购目标是当地薪资税务申报、桌面许可或特定银行，则必须独立核对。这些是选型边界，不是与竞品的已审核替代关系，原有未审核关系保持不批准。

sections.title_en: A downloaded transaction still needs accounting review
sections.title_zh: 下载交易后仍需会计复核
sections.en:
The bank-feed page describes selecting a bank, signing in, choosing accounts and a historical range, then connecting. It explicitly notes that institutions are added or removed and offers manual uploads if a bank cannot be found. The historical range depends on the institution; do not treat one default description as a guarantee of complete migration.

A hypothetical acceptance case is a customer payment that already has an invoice record. Inspect whether the downloaded bank item matches the existing payment or creates a second record. Then test a bank fee, a transfer and a duplicate upload against a statement. These are proposed checks; imported data and a successful connection are not proof that the books reconcile.
sections.zh:
银行数据源页面介绍选择银行、登录、选择账户与历史范围，再建立连接；还明确说明支持机构会增减，找不到银行时可手工上传。可追溯历史范围取决于机构，不能把某个默认描述当成完整迁移保证。

可以假设一笔客户付款已有发票记录，检查下载的银行项目是匹配已有付款，还是形成第二笔记录；再结合对账单测试银行手续费、内部转账及重复上传。这些属于建议检查，导入数据和连接成功都不能证明账簿已对平。

sections.title_en: Keep invoice progress separate from payment and revenue
sections.title_zh: 区分开票进度、收款和收入
sections.en:
The invoicing page describes turning estimates into invoices, billable expenses, recurring invoices, status updates and progress invoicing against milestones or a portion of an estimate. Availability must be checked against the current plan matrix, rather than inferred from the general feature page.

For a hypothetical milestone job, agree the total and issue the first agreed portion, then inspect the remaining amount before sending the next invoice. Check tax, discounts and any billable expense independently. An invoice being sent or viewed is not evidence of a settled payment or the correct revenue-recognition treatment. No invoice, recurring schedule or payment was executed in this research.
sections.zh:
开票页介绍报价转发票、可转付费用、周期发票、状态更新，以及按里程碑或报价部分金额开票。是否可用仍需按当前套餐表核对，不能从通用功能页直接推定。

以假设的里程碑项目为例，先约定总金额，开出首笔约定部分，再在下一次开票前检查剩余金额；税项、折扣及转付费用需分别核对。发票已发送或已查看，不证明付款已结算，也不能证明收入确认处理正确。本文未执行发票、周期计划或付款。

sections.title_zh: 套餐限制会影响实际工作
sections.en:
The current pricing matrix lists one user for Simple Start, three for Essentials, five for Plus and twenty-five for Advanced, with accountant access described separately. Essentials adds bills and multiple currencies. Plus lists inventory, purchase orders, projects and profitability; Advanced lists custom reporting, spreadsheet sync, backup/restore and workflow automation.

Select the smallest plan covering the actual users and work, then verify precise permissions and limits in the account. Inventory on a plan is not proof of every warehouse or manufacturing function. Advanced backup/restore should not be attributed to the lower plans. A shared login is not an appropriate substitute for evaluating the listed user allowance.
sections.zh:
当前定价表列出 Simple Start 1 用户、Essentials 3 用户、Plus 5 用户、Advanced 25 用户，会计访问另行说明。Essentials 增加账单及多币种；Plus 列出库存、采购订单、项目和盈利分析；Advanced 列出自定义报表、电子表格同步、备份恢复及工作流自动化。

应选择覆盖实际用户和任务的最小套餐，再在账户中核对具体权限及限制。套餐有库存不代表覆盖全部仓储制造功能；Advanced 的备份恢复也不能算到较低套餐。共享登录不能替代对用户额度的评估。

sections.title_en: Live price was unavailable, while offer conditions were readable
sections.title_zh: 实时价格未读出，但优惠条件可读
sections.en:
The pricing page read on 22 October 2026 showed a live-price loading message and dashes instead of amounts. This record therefore leaves currency and normalized monthly price unknown rather than taking a search snippet or another country’s price. The page describes a thirty-day trial and a separate Buy Now discount; the stated discount terms exclude the trial when that purchase path is chosen.

The terms describe monthly renewal after the offer, cancellation effective at period end and no prorated refund for that monthly period. Third-party apps may have separate terms and fees. Confirm the selected country, currency, tax, billing period and renewal amount at checkout; no checkout was completed and this research did not establish a permanent free plan.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的定价页显示实时价格加载提示，金额位置为横线。因此本档案将币种及归一月费保持未知，不采用搜索片段或其他国家价格。页面介绍 30 天试用，以及另行提供的 Buy Now 折扣；其折扣条款说明选择该购买路径就不享受试用。

条款说明优惠后按月续费，取消在账期末生效，该月账期不按比例退款；第三方应用可能有独立条件和费用。结账时应确认国家、币种、税费、账期和续费金额。本文未完成结账，也未确立永久免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Read the conditions under the AI features
sections.title_zh: 阅读 AI 功能附带条件
sections.en:
The current matrix labels some automation/chat features as beta with limited capacity. Its footnotes say AI outputs are currently English-only and Finance AI is available only in Advanced and not for customers with multicurrency enabled. That is a material incompatibility to check for a business that wants both capabilities.

Prepare an evaluation with opening balances, one sales/bank cycle and a period-end report. Inspect how the retained plan handles exceptions and ask for export and recovery evidence. The public invoicing page also contains older device-language in its footer; this research does not treat those lines as a current supported-browser matrix. No AI accuracy, restore reliability, local statutory reporting or mobile feature parity was tested.
sections.zh:
当前套餐表把部分自动化及聊天功能标为有容量限制的 beta。脚注说明 AI 输出当前仅为英文，Finance AI 只适用于 Advanced，且不适用于启用多币种的客户。若企业同时需要两者，这就是需要核对的实质不兼容条件。

可准备期初余额、一轮销售银行交易及期末报表进行评估，检查最终保留套餐如何处理异常，并取得导出和恢复证据。公开发票页面页脚还含较旧设备描述，本文不把这些文字当成当前浏览器支持表。未测试 AI 准确性、恢复可靠性、当地法定报表或移动端功能一致性。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Live prices did not load; country/currency, tax, checkout and payment availability were not established.
research_gaps.zh: 实时价格未加载；未确立国家币种、税费、结账及支付可用性。

research_gaps.en: Finance AI excludes multicurrency accounts; release/plan entitlement and actual AI behavior require an account check.
research_gaps.zh: Finance AI 排除多币种账户；版本套餐权限及实际 AI 行为需在账户内检查。

research_gaps.en: No bank match, migration, tax filing, inventory workflow, mobile parity or recovery was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试银行匹配、迁移、税务申报、库存流程、移动端一致性或恢复。
